acceptance.observed: A self-service matter is opened through the same matter id with no new matter/event; the overview reads the existing record. Browser steps 01-08 cover overview plus the seven other tabs and assert the same data-matter-id throughout. The language probe confirms per-target route/language aggregation for two targets, including en-US.

Revoking target A's confirmation invalidates only A's approval; revision, figure, check and rule-pack changes recompute approval validity live with exact reasons. Activity rows derive their outcome from each stored action and the workbench never synthesizes an event: a job.failed row stays failed, and the V6-17 retry path is a distinct job id whose own job.succeeded row appears separately. The V6-17 regression suite also proves failed retry creates a new job (retryOfJobId set). No same-job terminal-transition enforcement is claimed.

Refresh/retry reloads the same matter state and keeps one confirmation and one event; repeated reads do not add duplicate activity. Activity loading, empty, error and stale states are explicitly rendered.

limitations: The workbench component is exported but not registered in V6App/navigation; shared registration is orchestrator-owned and remains unverified.
Browser evidence uses a synthetic in-memory LocalRepository mount; native IndexedDB, app routing and full-shell navigation are unverified.

LocalRepository does not enforce job terminal transitions: a same-job job.failed followed by a current-version job.succeeded event can be stored. V6-22 does not claim to prevent that; the workbench derives display outcomes from each stored action and never creates events. V6-17's supported retry path uses a new job id.
The 检查 tab shows persisted check state but does not mount V6-23's run panel: V6-22 has no rule-pack/check-input configuration in its public inputs, so running checks remains V6-23's surface.
The deliver and filing tabs show readiness/empty states; V6-20 preview and export panels are not mounted in this workbench revision. No signature, submission or official-receipt claim is made.
Activity producers for every future action kind do not exist in R1; only repository events are rendered.
No real provider, network call or customer material was used.
Node 25.8.1 was used; the architecture target Node 22 remains unverified.

decisionsRequested.decision: LocalRepository does not enforce same-job terminal transitions (a job.succeeded event after job.failed is accepted if the write is otherwise valid). V6-22 derives activity outcomes and never synthesizes events, and V6-17 retries create new job ids; confirm this narrowed boundary or add a repository terminal guard before R2.
decisionsRequested.impact: Activity truthfulness under a hostile/incorrect writer; R1 UI path unaffected.
